Full incipit: 'chāyāvatīm ānandavallīm'. The rāga name is in the text (rāga-mudrā).

Hint confirmed. Guru Guha Vaibhavam posts 'Ekaamra Naathaaya' (Vīravasanta, 21 Aug 2007) right before 'Ekaamra Naathaaya Namaste' (Mukhāri, 22 Aug 2007), which matches n=30 and n=31. Pallavi: 'ekāmranāthāya namaste ekāneka phaladāya'. The DB already holds the Mukhāri one (n=31). Caveat: that DB row's guru-guha reference URL (…/2007/08/dikshitar-kriti-ekaamra-naathaaya.html) looks like the Vīravasanta post, so check that the DB recordings really are Mukhāri.

Only one source found: karnatik c9646 'gajAnanAya namastE', śaṅkarābharaṇam/rūpaka, which credits it to AMBI DIKSHITAR, not Muttusvāmi. Guru Guha Vaibhavam goes straight from gajānanayutam to gajāmbā nāyako with no gajānanāya namaste, and Wikipedia does not list it. I could not confirm it is the same text as Samāhāram n=74.
Full incipit: 'gānalole bāle'. karnatik gives the tāla only as 'cApu'; Guru Guha Vaibhavam and 4carnaticmusic say miśra cāpu.
Full incipit: 'himagirikumāri īśapriyakari'. This is a different kṛti from n=477 'himagirikumāri īśvari' (Ravikriyā/ādi, Tañjāvūr), which is in the DB.

Full incipit: 'kumbheśvareṇa saṃrakṣito'ham'. Caveat: the DB row for n=61 (kumbheśvarāya namaste, Kalyāṇi cāpu) cites the guru-guha 'kumbhesvarena' post as its lyric reference, so its source site may have mixed the two up.
Hint confirmed. Guru Guha Vaibhavam posts the Kalyāṇi/miśra cāpu kṛti on 29 Sep 2007 and the Kedāram/rūpakam one on 30 Sep 2007, so n=61 is Kalyāṇi (in the DB) and n=62 is Kedāram (missing).
Full incipit: 'kāmeśvareṇa saṃrakṣito'ham'. Shaivam also lists it as śrī/ādi.

Wikipedia also lists a Gamakakriyā kṛti, 'kāmākṣi māṃ pāhi karuṇākari'. The Samāhāram has only one 'kāmākṣi māṃ pāhi', and in the Guru Guha sequence the Śuddhadeśi one sits between kāmākṣi kāmakoṭi (51) and kāmākṣīṃ kalyāṇīm (54).
Pallavi: 'madhurāmbāyāḥ tava dāso'ham'. karnatik's title is garbled as 'madhurAmbikayAh stava'. Wikipedia's 'Triputa' and the 'cāpu'/'miśra cāpu' given elsewhere are the same 7-beat cycle.

Rāga is certain. Tāla sources disagree: Guru Guha Vaibhavam, Wikipedia and 4carnaticmusic say ādi; karnatik c5778 and Shaivam (which seems to copy karnatik) say rūpaka. Do not confuse with 'cintaye mahāliṅgamūrtim', also in Paraju/ādi.

Confirmed that 'pūjite' is in the pallavi. Guru Guha Vaibhavam's three paradevate posts run namaste (Ānandabhairavi, 21 Jan 2008), bhakta [pūjite] (Husenī, 22 Jan), bhava (Śaṅkarābharaṇam noṭṭusvara, 23 Jan), which matches n=173–175.
